seedValue.description: A color seed as a 6-digit hex: a string applies to both schemes, a [light, dark] tuple splits them (Astryx TokenValue semantics).

colorValue.description: A CSS color applied verbatim: a string applies to both schemes, a [light, dark] tuple splits them.

schemaVersion.description: Appearance document format version. v1 (antd-shaped light/dark documents) is not readable since FR-3605 — see the theme migration guide.

theme.description: The Astryx-vocabulary half: everything that feeds the theme pipeline.

fontFamily.description: The font family applied to both schemes.

siderMode.description: Forces the sider chrome's polarity regardless of the site's dark mode status. Omit to follow the page scheme.

families.description: Selectable theme families keyed by family id. 'default' must exist; other entries appear in the family selector with their branding.familyLabels label.

seeds.description: Brand color seeds. Roles derive from these: brand uses accent, admin uses info, secondary uses success.

branding.description: Structural metadata no theme token can express.

logo.description: Properties to customize the site's logo, considering both light and dark modes.

src.description: The source of the logo image.

srcCollapsed.description: The source of the collapsed logo image.

srcDark.description: The source of the logo image in dark mode.

srcCollapsedDark.description: The source of the collapsed logo image in dark mode.

alt.description: The alt text for the logo image.

href.description: The URL that the logo links to.

loginLogoSrc.description: The login form logo for light mode. Falls back to srcDark, then the default path.

loginLogoSrcDark.description: The login form logo for dark mode. Falls back to src, then the default path.

aboutLogoSrc.description: The about modal logo for light mode. Falls back to srcDark, then the default path.

aboutLogoSrcDark.description: The about modal logo for dark mode. Falls back to src, then the default path.

companyName.description: The name of the company or organization.

brandName.description: The name of the brand or product.

familyLabels.description: Family selector labels keyed by family id; falls back to the id.
